recruitmentMetrics._methodology: MONOTONIC FUNNEL (rank roll-up) with OA/EVERGREEN/POOLING/EXCLUDE_HASHES exclusions applied. Stage ranks: Initial Interview=1, Client Endorsement=2, Client Interview=3, Job Offer=4, Offer Accepted/Ongoing Contract=5, Started=6, Failed=0. A match at rank K emits one dated event for every rank R<=K (it must have passed through them), dated by: rank1 interview_at, rank2 submitted_at, rank3 interview_at, rank4 offer_at, rank5 offer_at (fallback hired_at) - the offer_accepted date, NOT the move-to-Started date, since Manatal's hired_at fires on the Started transition and can drift days after acceptance (2026-09-23 fix) - rank6 updated_at; each falling back to updated_at when null. Events are pooled per CANDIDATE. For month M and rank R, a candidate is counted if they have any event in M at rank >= R, which makes Interviews>=Endorsed>=ClientPass>=Offers>=Hires>=Starts true by construction. YTD totals are unique candidates by max rank reached, so YTD is NOT the sum of the months. EXCLUSIONS: (a) Outsource Accelerator internal orgs 599280 and 1619851; (b) EVERGREEN REQUISITION org 1560151; (c) any job whose position_name contains 'POOLING'; (d) 10 EXCLUDE_HASHES per manatal/constants.py. Position type is derived from Manatal custom_fields.justification: 'NEW LOGO' and 'NEW REQUIREMENT' both map to New Logo (both labels are treated as one bucket - Manatal's dropdown was renamed and legacy jobs still carry the old label); 'RAMP' -> Ramp; 'BACKFILL' -> Backfill; any other value is Unclassified and excluded from positionTypes[] conversions. A candidate active on jobs of multiple types is counted in EACH type.

_schema.monthly[]: Per-month funnel counts (interviews/endorsed/clientPass/offers/hires/starts), conversion percentages, TTF and role-flow fields from that month's snapshot.
_schema.ytdTotals: Unique candidates reaching each rank across the full period.
_schema.overallConversion: YTD conversion percentages computed from ytdTotals.
_schema.kpiSnapshot: KPI vs target keyed by metric, each {actual, target, status, note?}. Status: green = at/above target, yellow = within 10 points below, red = further below, gray = no target or no data.
_schema.positionTypes[]: New Logo / Ramp / Backfill roles filled, avg & median TTF, currently-open counts, and per-type candidate funnel conversions (intToEnd/endToClientPass/endToHire/intToHire/offerToStart). Position type comes from Manatal custom_fields.justification (NEW LOGO + NEW REQUIREMENT -> New Logo, RAMP -> Ramp, BACKFILL -> Backfill). A candidate active on jobs of multiple types is counted in each type. _funnel exposes the raw unique-candidate counts behind each conversion.
_schema.agingBuckets: Currently-open HEADCOUNT by days open (d0_30/d31_45/d46_60/d61_90/gt90), recomputed from the current month's aging.jobs, with each job's days-open recomputed from its opened date as of _generated (the snapshot freezes days at snapshot-build time), with each job's days-open recomputed from its opened date as of _generated (the snapshot freezes days at snapshot-build time), with each job's days-open recomputed from its opened date as of _generated (the snapshot freezes days at snapshot-build time), with each job's days-open recomputed from its opened date as of _generated (the snapshot freezes days at snapshot-build time).
_schema.oldestOpen[]: Top 10 oldest currently-open roles, oldest first by days open; days recomputed as of _generated; days recomputed as of _generated; days recomputed as of _generated; days recomputed as of _generated.
_schema.insights: Derived narrative: best/weakest month, TTF trend, longest-TTF position type, biggest bottleneck and recommended action.
_schema.dataGaps[]: Known holes in the underlying data.

recruiterMetrics._source: Manatal matches Jan 1 - 2026-09-29 (matches_2026_v7.json), attributed at the CANDIDATE level: candidate_id in data/recruiter_override.json -> tracker recruiter; otherwise most-recent match.owner mapped via RECRUITER_MAP (unknown owners -> Other). OA internal orgs (599280, 1619851), EVERGREEN org 1560151, POOLING positions, and 10 EXCLUDE_HASHES dropped.
recruiterMetrics._methodology: Rank-rollup per (recruiter, candidate). Stage ranks: Initial Interview=1, Client Endorsement=2, Client Interview=3, Job Offer=4, Offer Accepted/Ongoing=5, Started=6. A rank-K match emits events at ranks 1..K, dated per stage: rank1 interview_at, rank2 submitted_at, rank3 interview_at, rank4 offer_at, rank5 offer_at (fallback hired_at) - the offer_accepted date, NOT the move-to-Started date, since Manatal's hired_at fires on the Started transition and can drift days after acceptance, misbucketing late-month accepteds - rank6 updated_at. Each falls back to updated_at when null. Per (recruiter, month, rank), unique candidates are counted after rollup - guaranteeing Int >= End >= CP >= Off >= Hire >= Start. Attribution is CANDIDATE-LEVEL (not per match): a candidate's entire funnel activity is credited to a single recruiter, so the same candidate never appears under two recruiters. YTD totals are unique-candidate counts at each rank (never a sum of monthly buckets).
dataGaps: Candidate-level attribution: a candidate with matches under multiple owners is credited to ONE recruiter (tracker override if present, else most-recent match.owner). This intentionally consolidates funnel activity to preserve monotonicity.
OA internal hires (org_ids 599280 + 1619851), EVERGREEN, POOLING, and 10 EXCLUDE_HASHES are filtered out (matches recruitment_metrics.json).
Ellie owner_ids (225662, 89009) and Marc/me (816616) route to Other via non-membership in RECRUITER_MAP; underlying Manatal ownership on those matches is unchanged.
recruiterMetrics._note_override: Per-candidate tracker override applied to ALL funnel stages (not just hires) to guarantee monotonicity per recruiter/month. Tracker-listed candidates get 100% of their funnel activity credited to the tracker recruiter; non-tracker candidates use match.owner (most-recent, candidate-level).
recruiterMetrics._note_rank5_fix: 2026-09-23: rank-5 (Hire) events now dated by offer_at first, hired_at as fallback (was hired_at first). Manatal's hired_at fires when a candidate is moved to the Started stage and can drift 1-3 days after offer acceptance, misbucketing late-month accepteds into the following month. Impact: Iyah Jun +4, Mark Jun +1; rank-6 (Started) dating unchanged.
